control.scope: Predeclared development seeds; no final qualification

expanded.scope: Predeclared development seeds; no final qualification

interpretation: Same frozen weights and CPU host. Marginal exploratory whole-deal intervals; not multiplicity-adjusted. All count/rule/reference cells retained. Expanded-reference superiority is not assumed and this experiment cannot qualify a model.
decision: Do not promote the expanded menu as a strength improvement. Same-weight gains are small and inconclusive; economic5p and some Recharged/sealed subgroups regress. Full-sealed opposition does not establish a robust improvement. No training or qualification.
